data.narrative:
Figure AI, a Series C-stage AI & Software company, is valued at $39B according to funding tracker data. However, this valuation warrants material scrutiny. The company has raised $1B+ cumulatively, making the stated $39B imply a ratio exceeding 20x total capital deployed—a flag suggesting the recorded post-money may reflect a data error or alternative funding structure not captured in standard databases.

Stage-progression methodology, which would apply a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the base valuation, is therefore inapplicable. Peer-median triangulation is the sole reliable method here. Against a same-sector, same-stage comp set of 3 private AI & Software companies—Skild AI ($14.0B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B), and Together AI ($8.3B)—the median implied valuation is $10.0B. The peer range spans $8.3B to $14.0B.

Our analysis supports a valuation band of $8.5B to $11.5B, centered on $10.0B. The material gap between this range and the claimed $39B reflects high uncertainty around the authenticity of the tracker-reported post-money. Key risks to this assessment include: whether Figure AI has closed undisclosed financing at materially higher terms, proprietary robotics IP not reflected in software-sector comps, or structural differences in burn/profitability relative to the peer set. Additional diligence on actual capitalization documents is essential before placing weight on valuations above the $11.5B ceiling.
